ticker_scroll.css: @keyframes ticker_scroll { 0% { transform: translateX(0); } 100% { transform: translateX(-50%); } } .ticker-track { display: flex; width: max-content; animation: ticker_scroll 60s linear infinite; }

live_strobe.css: @keyframes live_strobe { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(255,0,51,0.7); } 50% { opacity: 0.85; box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px rgba(255,0,51,0); } } .live-badge { animation: live_strobe 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; background: #FF0033; color: #fff; }

player_card_glow.css: .player-card { transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease; border: 1px solid #262626; } .player-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(255,0,51,0.6); border-color: #FF0033; }

score_count_up.css: @keyframes score_count_up { 0% { transform: translateY(100%); opacity: 0; } 100% { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; } } .match-score { display: inline-block; animation: score_count_up 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1) both; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

home.layout: Sticky black nav with live score ticker bar below; full-bleed hero featuring next match/announcement; 3-col news grid with video thumbs; matches schedule table; roster spotlight strip; sponsor logo bar; Discord CTA banner.

teams.layout: Page title with game filter tabs; responsive grid of large team cards (logo, game icon, ranking, W-L record) linking to roster pages.

roster.layout: Team banner header with crest and record; grid of player cards with photo, IGN, role, country flag, socials; secondary rows for coaches and staff.

schedule.layout: Tabbed Upcoming/Results view with tournament-grouped match rows showing logos, date/time, game, score, and stream link; sidebar filters by team and game.

shop.layout: Top limited-drop countdown banner; category nav (Jerseys, Hoodies, Accessories); product grid cards with image, name, price, size selector; signed merch highlighted section.
